slides.head:
YouTube Music now tells you
when a song was made by AI.
A new label.
slides.body: A tag on the player page marks songs made primarily with generative AI. Tap it to see the AI's role in the track.

slides.head: Three categories.
slides.body: Partners mark each track Fully Gen AI, Partly Gen AI or No Gen AI. Pitch correction like Auto-Tune counts as No Gen AI.

slides.head:
No disclosure?
It checks anyway.
slides.body: YouTube adds signals from its own detection tools. Tracks with no AI info can still be labeled.

slides.head: 90,000 a day.
slides.body: Deezer says it gets nearly 90,000 fully AI-generated tracks daily. Spotify and TIDAL already tag AI music. Apple Music plans labels this year.

slides.head:
Using AI in a track?
Say so up front.
slides.body: Per TechCrunch, AI use alone does not block a track from monetization.
